description: Android Fragment implementing the main home screen with hero carousel, continue watching and TV channels rails, focus management, auto-scrolling, and composed top navigation bar.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: Main Android Fragment for the home screen, managing UI components like hero carousel, rails, focus, and auto-scrolling with ViewModel integration.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes repository and ViewModel for data management.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Constructs the view hierarchy, including root scroll, container, compose top nav, hero carousel, and content rails.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets initial focus and observes ViewModel LiveData for state updates.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Re-establishes focus and resumes hero auto-scroll.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Stops hero auto-scroll and cancels ongoing animations.

methods.name: observeViewModelStates
methods.description: Subscribes to ViewModel data states and updates UI components accordingly.

methods.name: showContinueWatchingLoading
methods.description: Displays loading indicator for continue watching section.

methods.name: hideContinueWatchingLoading
methods.description: Hides continue watching loading indicator.

methods.name: showTvChannelsLoading
methods.description: Displays loading indicator for TV channels section.

methods.name: hideTvChannelsLoading
methods.description: Hides TV channels loading indicator.

methods.name: showErrorWithRetry
methods.description: Displays error message and schedules retry.

methods.name: updateContinueWatchingRail
methods.description: Populates the continue watching rail with data.

methods.name: updateTvChannelsRail
methods.description: Populates the TV channels rail with data.

methods.name: addComposeTopNavBar
methods.description: Adds the top navigation bar as a ComposeView, setting focus and key handling.

methods.name: setupHeroBanner
methods.description: Configures hero carousel with sizing, auto-scroll, focus, and focus handling logic.

methods.name: centerHeroAt
methods.description: Centers a hero card in the viewport with optional animation, maintaining peeking and padding.

methods.name: pauseAutoScrollForUserInteraction
methods.description: Temporarily pauses auto-scrolling during user interaction.

methods.name: startHeroAutoScroll
methods.description: Begins automatic hero carousel advancing every 3 seconds.

methods.name: stopHeroAutoScroll
methods.description: Stops automatic hero carousel scrolling.

methods.name: setupContinueWatchingSection
methods.description: Builds the continue watching horizontal rail with title, loading, and cards.

methods.name: setupTvChannelsSection
methods.description: Builds the TV channels horizontal rail with title, loading, and cards.

methods.name: setRailsFocusable
methods.description: Enables or disables focusability of content rails for focus gating.

methods.name: dpToPx
methods.description: Converts density-independent pixels (dp) to pixels (px).
